_about: Example only: an image and document format converter (png, webp, heic, pdf, docx). Copy this to seo/keywords.config.json and replace every list with the vocabulary of the product you are working on. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_languages: media_words must be written in every language the project targets. English-only lists make a non-English market look empty instead of unfiltered. Three languages are shown here; add one block of words per market.
media_words: (画像|写真|書類|文書|ファイル|資料|ページ)
on_topic: (変換|圧縮|サイズ変更|結合|分割|トリミング)

off_intent._why: a download search wants somebody else's file, unless it names a format we handle
the verb alone is an editing product; paired with a format it is a conversion search
printing and shipping a document is a print shop, not a converter
